rounds: I'd be happy for AI to write my emails, as long as nobody knew.
In ten years, I'll be doing a job that doesn't exist yet.
A company that replaces workers with AI should pay a special tax.
I'd trust an AI doctor more than a tired human one.
Unions matter more today than they did fifty years ago.
If my job disappeared, I'd see it as a chance rather than a disaster.
Workers should get a share of the money a company saves with AI.
Students who use AI to write their essays are just being smart.
